css: .sp-scr-03, .sp-scr-03 * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.sp-scr-03 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--brand-font, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--brand-text, #222); background: var(--brand-background, #f5f5f5); }
.sp-scr-03 h1, .sp-scr-03 h2 { font-weight: var(--brand-title-weight, 600); }
.sp-scr-03 .shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 144px 1fr; min-height: 900px; }
.sp-scr-03 .rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px 8px; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #e3e7ee; }
.sp-scr-03 .rail-logo { display: block; margin: 0 0 16px; max-width: 100%; align-self: flex-start; }
.sp-scr-03 .rail-link { padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; }
.sp-scr-03 .rail-link.active { background: var(--brand-primary); color: #fff; }
.sp-scr-03 .main { padding: 24px 32px; }
.sp-scr-03 .topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.sp-scr-03 .bell { font: inherit; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cfd6e0; background: #fff; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.sp-scr-03 .badge { display: inline-block; min-width: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--brand-error); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; }
.sp-scr-03 .grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }
.sp-scr-03 .grid th, .sp-scr-03 .grid td { text-align: left; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef1f5; }
.sp-scr-03 .grid tbody tr { cursor: pointer; }
.sp-scr-03 .tag { display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--brand-info); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; }
.sp-scr-03 .panel { position: fixed; top: 64px; right: 24px; width: 300px; background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14); padding: 12px 16px; }
.sp-scr-03 .note { list-style: none; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef1f5; }
.sp-scr-03 .note time { display: block; font-size: 12px; opacity: .7; }
.sp-scr-03 [hidden] { display: none !important; }
guesses: The film window is 1440 by 900 px, so the shell's min-height of 100vh is 900px.
